Name: Transfer
Description: Transfers the objects selected from the From value to the To value of the Level chosen in the drop-downs.

Name: Settings
Description: Opens the DynALisp settings: the language, the reactors, the overrides and the updates.

Name: Suite
Description: Turns each command on or off, edits its aliases and opens its docs.

Name: User Files
Description: Lists your copies of the data files, resets them, and exports or imports your settings.

Name: Info
Description: Shows the version of DynALisp and what changed, and checks for updates.

Name: Docs
Description: Opens the docs of every module installed.

Name: Reload
Description: Loads every module of DynALisp again.
